# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 (volume 1)  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty little girl with rosy cheeks, bright black eyes, and glossy black hair. She has a cheery, merry expression and enviable soulful eyes. Though an inch shorter than Anne, she has a plump and graceful figure.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022)_

## Personality

Diana is a cheerful, polite, and well-behaved girl who enjoys playing, singing, and reading. She possesses a very practical mind compared to her friend Anne, though she has a playful side and laughs easily. While raised strictly by her mother, she is a loyal, faithful friend who is deeply affectionate, honest, and generous with others.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c12 P45](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0045), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c17 P30](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0030), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017)_

## History

Diana Barry grows up as the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. George Barry at Orchard Slope in Avonlea. In June, Matthew Cuthbert mentions her to Anne Shirley, noting her age and beauty. After returning from a visit to her aunt at Carmody, Diana meets Anne for the first time in the Orchard Slope garden and the two girls solemnly swear an oath of eternal bosom friendship over a imaginary running stream. They build a playhouse called 'Idlewild' in Mr. William Bell's birch grove and share many imaginative adventures. In October, Diana visits Green Gables for tea, where Anne accidentally serves her homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. Unaware of what she is drinking, Diana consumes three tumblerfuls, becomes intoxicated and sick, and has to be helped home. Her strict mother, believing Anne intentionally got Diana drunk, forbids the girls from ever speaking or playing together again. They share a dramatic, tearful farewell by the Dryad's Bubble spring, exchanging locks of hair and vows of lifelong devotion. Diana secretly passes a note and a handmade tissue paper bookmarker to Anne in school to reassure her of her love. Months later, Diana's younger sister Minnie May contracts a severe case of croup while their parents are away at a political rally in Charlottetown.

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Orchard Slope without any sisters close to her age  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>
- Was named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her family when she was born  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>
- Has a wealthy, strict greataunt named Josephine Barry living in Charlottetown  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 c19 P60](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0060)</sub>
